rule: D24 re-check pass of the D11 matching audit (D19, D20), issue #71
scope: The 3 sampled World rows confirmed by the #53 audit whose actual changed under the D41 GEP World rule (#70), reported as pending_recheck after #70.
how: Rows found by comparing data/graded/numeric/world-bank-gep.json with data/graded/audit/audited-grades-53.json (6e11858) for every confirmed sampled id. Forecasts and actuals re-read from the GEP Table 1.1 PDFs (World Bank thedocs zips and PDFs, fetched 2026-10-02, pdftotext -layout), weights base from each table note, not from repo files; verdict recomputed under D18.

grade_rechecked.actual_vintage: World Bank GEP 2021-01, real GDP growth table (column 2020e)

checked.actual_series: World real GDP growth at 2010 prices (GEP headline aggregate), GEP January 2021 (2020e), the latest later table on 2010 prices

evidence.title: GEP January 2019, Table 1.1 (GEP-January-2019-gdp-growth.pdf)
evidence.shows: World 2020f = 2.8; note 1: aggregate growth rates calculated using constant 2010 U.S. dollar GDP weights.

evidence.title: GEP January 2021, Table 1.1 (GEP-January-2021-gdp-growth.pdf)
evidence.shows: World 2020e = -4.3; note 1: GDP weights at 2010 prices and market exchange rates. The last edition on 2010 prices: June 2021 moves to average 2010-19 prices (its note 1 says so).

world-bank-gep-2019-01-002.note: Forecast 2.8 and actual -4.3 verified in the GEP tables; same weights base (2010 prices) in forecast and actual; error +7.1 pp, D18 miss. The #53 audit confirmed the WDI-based grade (actual -2.886, miss); D41 moved World to the GEP's own same-base statement.

grade_rechecked.actual_vintage: World Bank GEP 2024-06, real GDP growth table (column 2021)

checked.actual_series: World real GDP growth at average 2010-19 prices (GEP headline aggregate), GEP June 2024 (2021), the latest later table on average 2010-19 prices that prints 2021

evidence.title: GEP June 2021, Table 1.1 (GEP-June-2021-gdp-growth.pdf)
evidence.shows: World 2021f = 5.6, 2022f = 4.3; note 1: GDP weights at average 2010-19 prices and market exchange rates.

evidence.title: GEP June 2024, Table 1.1 (GEP-June-2024-gdp-growth.pdf)
evidence.shows: World 2021 = 6.3 (columns 2021, 2022, 2023e); note 1: average 2010-19 prices. January 2025 and later tables start at 2022.

world-bank-gep-2021-06-001.note: Forecast 5.6 and actual 6.3 verified in the GEP tables; same weights base (average 2010-19 prices) in forecast and actual; error -0.7 pp, D18 partial. The #53 audit confirmed the WDI-based grade (actual 6.485, partial); D41 moved World to the GEP's own same-base statement.

grade_rechecked.actual_vintage: World Bank GEP 2025-06, real GDP growth table (column 2022)

checked.actual_series: World real GDP growth at average 2010-19 prices (GEP headline aggregate), GEP June 2025 (2022), the latest later table on average 2010-19 prices that prints 2022

evidence.title: GEP January 2026 and June 2026, Table 1.1
evidence.shows: Both start at 2023 (also average 2010-19 prices; June 2026: https://thedocs.worldbank.org/en/doc/2b672b3b0415d6b66c45b66579db4ef5-0050012026/related/GEP-Jun-2026-gdp-growth.pdf), so June 2025 is the latest statement of 2022.

world-bank-gep-2021-06-002.note: Forecast 4.3 and actual 3.3 verified in the GEP tables; same weights base (average 2010-19 prices) in forecast and actual; error +1.0 pp, D18 partial. The error sits on the 1.0-point threshold; the actual is printed to one decimal, so the row carries the D41 threshold flag (partial or miss), graded partial on the stated values. The #53 audit confirmed the WDI-based grade (actual 3.44, partial); D41 moved World to the GEP's own same-base statement.
